rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for Friday.

example.english: Let’s have dinner together on Friday.
example.traditional: 星期五我哋一齊食飯啦。
example.jyutping: sing1 kei4 ng5 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1

rows.note: Use this as a common colloquial alternative to 星期五.

example.jyutping: lai5 baai3 ng5 nei5 dak1 haan4 m4 haan4

rows.note: Use this shorter, more written-style form, especially in schedules or other written contexts.

example.english: The meeting has been moved to 10 a.m. on Friday.
example.traditional: 周五個會改咗朝早十點。
example.jyutping: zau1 ng5 go3 wui6 goi2 zo2 ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2
